as_told.title: 1949 emergency meeting on UFOs and nukes at Killeen base

plain: In 1949, after several sightings over Killeen Base at Camp Hood in Texas, which Michels says held America's largest store of nuclear weapons at the time, an emergency meeting about UFOs and nukes was reportedly held there. Michels tells it himself, citing Air Force documents from 1949 and the writer Robert Hastings, author of the book UFOs and Nukes. He says the Army's counter-intelligence corps, the FBI, the Office of Naval Intelligence and the CIA were all present, though in one telling he is unsure of the year. He raises it as evidence that the government was worried early on that UFOs were watching its nuclear weapons.
